images.title: Our journey through the chapter
images.purpose: Give the whole chapter as one journey: a winding road with a stop for each idea, in the order the student met them.
images.composition: A road that snakes across the canvas in 3 rows, with 14 round stops in order and the topic name beside each stop.
images.exact_structure: Plain white 16:9 canvas with one thick grey #6B7280 road with a thin white dashed centre line, winding in 3 rows like a snake. A small flag stands at the start of the road, at the left end of row 1, and a chequered finish flag stands at the end, after the last stop (the flags have no text). Small dark arrowheads on the road show the direction. There are exactly 14 round stops on the road, teal #0072B2 discs, each with a white flat picture inside (no text inside the picture) and its name written in dark text just under the disc. ROW 1, left to right, 5 stops: (1) a suitcase, Journeys and Big Numbers; (2) a sailing boat, Travelling Then and Now; (3) a stack of three round tokens, Large Numbers and Place Value; (4) an open book, Read the Numbers; (5) a pencil, Write the Numbers. The road turns down at the right end into ROW 2, right to left, 5 stops: (6) three small boxes joined by two arrows, Number Patterns; (7) a balance scale, Comparing and Ordering; (8) two small squares with two curved arrows swapping them, Digit Swap; (9) a bar broken into three pieces, Expanded Form; (10) a rabbit, Nearest Numbers. The road turns down at the left end into ROW 3, left to right, 4 stops: (11) a bus, Travelling in Different Vehicles; (12) a magnifying glass, Finding Large Numbers Around Us; (13) a puzzle piece, Puzzles on the Train; (14) a horse head, King's Horses, followed by the finish flag. No numbers anywhere, no other text.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The chapter is one journey: travel, large numbers, comparing, swapping, expanded form, nearest numbers, vehicles, large numbers around us, puzzles and the king's horses.
images.description: A winding road with 14 stops, one for each topic of the chapter in order, from Journeys and Big Numbers to King's Horses.
images.context: The chapter's whole path as a map, one stop per topic, in the plan's order. Four long topic names are shortened to fit: Large Numbers and Place Value, Comparing and Ordering, Expanded Form and Puzzles on the Train. The pictures are small hints of each topic and carry no numbers.
images.teaching_notes: Walk the road with the student and ask for one idea at each stop before showing the revision lines. The map has no numbers on purpose, so the student recalls the ideas rather than reading them.

image_decisions.why: A single journey map holds the whole chapter in order and is the natural visual for a revision of every idea.
